name: ss14-studio
description: All-in-one development studio for Space Station 14. Construction graphs first, everything else after.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ss14-studio/core && npm run build -w @ss14-studio/ui && npm run build -w ss14-studio
scripts.build:rider: npm run build:core && npm run build:ui && npm run build:rider:sidecar && npm run build:rider:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @ss14-studio/core && npm run typecheck -w @ss14-studio/ui && npm run typecheck -w ss14-studio && npm run typecheck -w @ss14-studio/rider-sidecar
scripts.test: npm run test -w @ss14-studio/core && npm run test -w @ss14-studio/ui && npm run test -w @ss14-studio/rider-sidecar
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w ss14-studio
